milestones.title: Unity port of the browser game

tasks.title: Port every system and screen from the HTML game
tasks.detail: The full game runs in Unity with scenes, prefabs and data assets; parity audits passed.

tasks.title: Floating islands, Spirit Bridges, no offline progress
tasks.detail: Regions became floating Islands linked by one-way bridges (ADR 0002, 0003).

tasks.title: Real balance: 2-3 h first run, machines beat hands mid-game
tasks.detail: TEST mode off by default; playthrough bot checks the pacing (ADR 0004).

tasks.title: Island onboarding quests
tasks.detail: Quests that teach bridges, caravans and cross-island trade, with next-step hints.

tasks.title: Island requesters design (ADR 0007)
tasks.detail: Answers 2026-10-12: fixed unlock order (Mine, Fishing, Farm, Grove, Volcano, Celestial), 1 NPC per island with 3 requests all open at once, right-click feeding only, Heavenly Gate ending, vows removed. Follow-up open on how many new islands.
tasks.blockedBy: Waiting for your follow-up answers (new islands: how many, where in the order)

tasks.title: Remove ascension (gate, points, perks, vows, prestige reset)
tasks.detail: Take out the Ascension Gate, Ascension Points, perk shop, vows and the run reset; old saves keep their progress.
tasks.blockedBy: Needs the requester design (ADR 0007) so nothing the game relies on is removed early

tasks.title: Build island requesters
tasks.detail: Requester buildings/NPCs per island with a request menu; each fulfilled request unlocks recipes.
tasks.blockedBy: Needs your answers on the requester design

tasks.title: New islands (Lotus Marsh, Thunder Crag, maybe Beast Ravine and Tribulation Peak)
tasks.detail: New islands in the unlock order, each with one NPC and new buildings; needs new island art.
tasks.blockedBy: Waiting for your follow-up answers, then ADR 0007 update and art request

tasks.title: South cliff walls, side faces, grass lips
tasks.detail: Islands show a 3-tile cliff on the south edge and a narrow earth face on the west/east edges, so they read as floating rock seen from above.
tasks.now: art loop: integrating deliveries as they arrive

tasks.title: Integrate vertical side walls (v2, with variants)
tasks.detail: Swap the rotated first version for the artist's corrected vertical side faces.

tasks.title: Integrate the new hanging undersides (3/4 rock, roots, vines)
tasks.detail: Replace the side-view rocks under the south cliffs with the redrawn 3/4 pieces.

tasks.title: Fishing ground patches (3rd version)
tasks.detail: Calm cool-grey shingle patches for the Fishing island; earlier two were rejected.

tasks.title: Rebuild the sky with the kept background islands
tasks.detail: Background islands now load from their own folder so new deliveries can't replace them.

tasks.title: Cliff wall seam and stripe fix
tasks.detail: The artist's cliff tiles still have transparent seams and a light-to-dark stripe per tile; patched in code for now.

tasks.title: Smooth stepped and long-straight coasts
tasks.detail: Diagonal coasts read as rows of short pillars; reshape the coastline so cliffs run in longer, natural stretches.
